about: The computer's own places (every folder, sqlite store, notes store and recordings folder a row of computer-sources.json describes), the two carried conversations (iMessage, WhatsApp) and Mac Contacts move from Trillion-X/trillion's computer/ into one Workshop tool, and every connected service's descriptors with the connect, rename, disconnect and grant code move into tools/pull-from-connected-accounts, so the Connections list reads computer places and connected services from one tool tree. Byte for byte: the next commits adapt them. The helper's main loop (computer/read-this-computer.mjs), always-on listening (computer/listen.mjs, another lane) and every other computer/ file stay and import what moved from the trillion-workshop package.

groups.capability: bring in what is new in each place on this computer (folders, sqlite stores, notes, recordings, pictures, carried conversations, contacts), each place a row
connect, rename and disconnect a service account and say what each operation's grants need, every service a descriptor row
groups.joins_tool: tools/pull-from-connected-accounts pulls from accounts already connected; it has no way to connect, rename or disconnect an account, no service descriptors and no grant check. This group brings those, so one tool lists and manages every connection.
